description: Push creator content to a market's official content channel. Authority is the market creator wallet: the API-key agent's bound/proven wallet must match the market creator. The `renderer` is a free-form string — see `kellian_discover_renderers` for the built-in catalog; custom strings remain protocol-valid and the official frontend ignores renderers it doesn't recognise.

EvmAddress.description: Checksummed or lowercase 20-byte EVM address (0x + 40 hex).

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

proofNonce.description: Required single-use nonce for the wallet proof. Fetch from POST /api/auth/nonce; consumed on verification so the proof cannot be replayed.

renderer.description: Free-form renderer identifier. Not validated against a closed list.

signatureTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) used in the signed challenge message

walletAddress.description: Wallet address of the caller (must be market creator)

walletSignature.description: Action-bound wallet proof. Sign the canonical 'problee-mcp-auth:…' challenge (binds agent, apiKey, tool, scope, chain, resource, payloadHash, nonce, timestamp).

name: kellian_push_content
title: Push a creator content envelope to the market's content channel
